text: Implemented Phase 10. Connectivity NodeAxis and EdgeSpace expose path-dependent finite locus domains while VertexBasis, topology, provenance, and vectorization order remain authoritative; EdgeMask exposes a locus region plus checked Boolean operations. Threshold scored Region is renamed ThresholdRegion, membership is a locus Region tied to MaskedField active support, and MaskedField exposes ordered support plus exact compact-to-volume Injection; exact grid compatibility and foreign-support rejection are enforced. RadialMaskOrder exposes ordered active-space Selection and a checked RadialLocusOrder with exact active-to-full Injection and reverse lookup while decode/layout policies remain intact. Verification: connectivity 64 JVM/64 JS, threshold 20 JVM/20 JS, latent 81 JVM/81 JS, warning-clean.
